title: Analytic: EME bend, whispering-gallery modes on a metal rim vs the Bessel ring, lossless straight | bend | straight (em_eme)
description:
A 6 um wide guide filled with n = 1.5 between two pec walls (y faces), em_eme along x (E_z, wavelength 1.55 um, n_modes 0 = the complete basis of the 598-cell lines), drawn straight: 1 um straight | 2 um eme_bend | 1 um straight. The bend has radius R (swept 10, 15, 30, 20 um; base 20 um, the last value) about reference = the y_hi wall, so the hi wall is the outer metal rim at r = R and the light in the bent section hugs it: whispering-gallery modes. Mesh: graded, 10 nm across the line (y, refinement on the filling with dx_x = the base size) and 250 nm slices along x (EME propagates exactly along x, so the slices only place the section ends; the validation warning about cells per wavelength comes from these long x cells and is expected).
Wall position: with ez a pec face pins E_z = 0 at the centre of its outermost cell (the em_fdfd_ez rule), so the rim is at y_wall = L_y - dy/2 and the straight walls are W = L_y - dy apart.
Analytic: the bent section solves the exact cylindrical line operator, E_z ~ J_nu(k0 n r) e^{-j nu theta}, J_nu(k0 n R) = 0 at the rim, n_eff = nu / (k0 R) (the inner wall, 6 um inside, is reached only by a < 1e-6 tail). Olver's expansion of the k-th zero (alpha_k = a_k / 2^(1/3), a_k the Airy zeros) k0 n R = nu + alpha_k nu^(1/3) + (3/10) alpha_k^2 nu^(-1/3) + (5 - alpha_k^3)/350 nu^(-1) - (479 alpha_k^4 + 20 alpha_k)/63000 nu^(-5/3), solved for nu by 4 fixed-point steps (truncation < 1e-6 relative for nu > 45). Straight sections: sin modes of the pec channel, discrete exact n_eff^2 = n^2 - (2 / (k0 dy))^2 sin^2(pi dy / (2 W)).
Derived values tab (R = 20 um): n_eff_bend_1 ~1.3869 and n_eff_bend_2 ~1.3026 (section table row 2 = the bent section, columns n_eff_1 / n_eff_2) vs the Bessel zeros; n_eff_straight_1 (row 1) vs the discrete sin mode; T_plus_R = eme_transmission + eme_reflection = 1 and the straight-bend interface reciprocity_defect = 0 (complete basis, lossless closed line: the mode matching conserves power exactly, though the straight sin mode excites many bent modes, so transmission_1 itself has no closed form).
Sweep tab: n_eff_bend_1, n_eff_bend_2 and T_plus_R versus R with the dashed references.
Expected agreement: n_eff of the bend ~1e-5 (second-order line discretisation at 10 nm; mode 2 ~3e-5, larger at R = 10 um), straight n_eff and the power / reciprocity identities ~1e-9 (rounding). A wall misplaced by half a cell would show as ~3e-4 in n_eff_bend_1 and ~6e-6 in n_eff_straight_1. Cost: the complete basis (598 modes per line) takes a few seconds per sweep value; only 16 slices, so the host estimate stays below 1 GB. Field tab: |E_z| through the straightened bend (the input sin mode feeding the rim-hugging gallery modes).

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the stationary solve

parameters.name: R_bend
parameters.description: rim radius = eme_bend radius at the reference (swept 10, 15, 30, 20 um)

parameters.name: dx_base
parameters.description: base cell size = slice length along x

parameters.name: L_y
parameters.description: width of the guide incl. the two pinned wall cells (600 cells)

parameters.name: y_wall
parameters.description: the rim: E_z = 0 at the centre of the pinned outermost y_hi cell; the bend reference

parameters.name: W_line
parameters.description: distance of the two pec planes (centres of the pinned cells)

parameters.name: bend_start
parameters.description: start of the bent range along x (a slice edge)

parameters.name: bend_stop
parameters.description: end of the bent range (arc length 2 um at the rim)

parameters.name: alpha_1
parameters.description: Olver coefficient of the first Bessel zero (1.8557571)

parameters.name: alpha_2
parameters.description: Olver coefficient of the second Bessel zero

parameters.name: x_ring
parameters.description: k0 n R: the Bessel argument at the rim

parameters.name: nu1_0
parameters.description: azimuthal order of mode 1, start of the fixed-point iteration

parameters.name: n1_ring
parameters.description: Bessel-ring n_eff of mode 1 (first zero j_nu,1 = k0 n R)

parameters.name: n1_straight
parameters.description: discrete-exact n_eff of the straight sin mode between the pec planes
